name: Early Ray Termination with Stereo Coherence
aliases: Guaranteeing Correct Stereoscopic Views with Early Termination
definition: An acceleration technique for volume rendering where ray traversal stops when accumulated opacity reaches 1.0. For stereoscopic rendering, this requires special handling to ensure samples ignored by the left-eye ray (due to early termination) do not cause errors in the right-eye ray.
summary: Early Ray Termination with Stereo Coherence accelerates stereoscopic volume rendering by bounding right-eye projections to prevent visual errors when left-eye rays terminate early.
